scope: Successor cross-check of the current Triggerword-5 P0 effect frontier: exact cmd_hook PreToolUse behavior, zulassen admission bookkeeping, PostToolUse outcome verification/fallback, causal_episodes creation and downstream gw_absicht interpretation of VERIFIED effects.

atoms.what_it_does: zulassen() evaluates capability, session generation, target preconditions and same-session idempotency, then records ZUGELASSEN/ABGELEHNT/WIEDERHOLUNG in effects and stores effect_id on active_turns. Unknown tool capabilities auto-register allowed. The function itself does not stop host execution.
known_counterevidence: The checked cmd_hook branch explicitly avoids emitting a normal deny/block decision after zulassen().
open_questions: Whether a separate host/executor authority consumes this decision before execution remains unproven.
Whether one active_turns.effect_id slot is safe under overlapping state-changing tool calls remains unproven.

atoms.what_it_does: The live PreToolUse dispatcher emits permissionDecision=deny only for a session-bound SEBUKKU marker. Otherwise it calls zulassen(data) as pre-execution bookkeeping and deliberately emits no deny/block response. PostToolUse then calls merken(data).
known_counterevidence: Because SEBUKKU can deny, the hook surface is technically capable of blocking; normal effect admission simply does not use that capability in this donor implementation.
open_questions: Triggerword 4 must choose the real deterministic successor gate at the executor/host boundary rather than assuming the donor journal is already an EffectGate.

atoms.what_it_does: merken() hashes/inspects the observed PostToolUse result. If a pre-row exists and was ZUGELASSEN it becomes VERIFIED or FEHLGESCHLAGEN; non-ZUGELASSEN statuses are preserved with an outcome append. If no PreToolUse row exists, merken() creates a new effects row directly as VERIFIED or FEHLGESCHLAGEN and notes the missing pre-row. It then creates causal_episodes with credit=0 and reentered=0.
known_counterevidence: PostToolUse success proves an observed tool outcome only to the strength of _wirkung_pruefen; it does not prove prior deterministic admission.
open_questions: UNKNOWN/transport-ambiguous outcomes need a first-class successor state; blind replay must remain forbidden.
causal_episodes reentered=0 here does not itself prove later observed re-entry.

atoms.what_it_does: _gw_absicht_schreiben treats effects rows with status='VERIFIED' as the state-changing outside-effect set (aussenwirkung) for the turn. Because merken() can mint VERIFIED when no PreToolUse row exists, VERIFIED is semantically overloaded between observed-success and admitted-then-verified execution.
known_counterevidence: If the host separately guaranteed admission for every PostToolUse event, the semantic risk would be reduced, but that external guarantee is not established by the inspected donor source.
open_questions: Audit every downstream consumer of effects.status to prevent the same semantic collapse during migration.

hypotheses: Frankenstein 2.0 should preserve the donor's useful two-phase request/outcome journal shape while splitting admission decision from observed outcome and causal re-entry into distinct typed fields/receipts.

The deterministic successor EffectGate belongs at the actual executor/host boundary; lifecycle hooks may remain audit/journal adapters but must not be mistaken for the effect authority when they fail open or emit no deny.
counterhypotheses: A host permission layer outside stern.py may already enforce execution admission, making the donor journal intentionally observational; this must be proven from exact host integration rather than inferred.
The single active_turns.effect_id slot may be safe if host execution is strictly serialized per session; concurrency risk remains OPEN rather than a proven bug.
contradictions: TW5-CONTRADICTION-EFFECT-ENFORCEMENT-003: the donor calls zulassen() an admission path and stores ABGELEHNT/WIEDERHOLUNG, but the live normal PreToolUse branch deliberately emits no deny/block decision; therefore donor admission-record semantics are not equivalent to deterministic EffectGate enforcement.

TW5-CONTRADICTION-VERIFIED-PREADMISSION-004: PostToolUse fallback may create status=VERIFIED without any PreToolUse row, while downstream gw_absicht interprets VERIFIED as aussenwirkung; observed-success and admitted-then-verified execution are therefore not structurally distinct in the current donor status field.
critical_unknowns: Exact host permission/executor path outside stern.py and whether it enforces star_faehigkeit/generation/precondition/idempotency before tool execution.
All downstream consumers of effects.status and whether any assume VERIFIED implies pre-admission.
Overlap/serialization guarantees for state-changing tool calls sharing active_turns.effect_id.
Exact unknown-outcome behavior for cancelled/truncated/transport-failed external effects.
First/last Git commit windows for the nonblocking admission design and missing-pre-row VERIFIED fallback.

recommended_next_spans.reason: Trace Realtime Function-Calling/tool bridge into stern/executor/effect paths and identify any direct bypass or independent permission boundary.
Enumerate downstream status consumers and causal/re-entry interpretation after gw_absicht.

recommended_next_spans.path: Git history for stern.py effect functions
recommended_next_spans.reason: Recover first/last commit windows for zulassen, merken fallback and effect-status semantics before Triggerword-4 migration.
